summary: The filing is a prospectus supplement filed by Amphenol Corporation under Rule 424(b)(5) for a public offering of €600 million 3.375% Senior Notes due 2029 and €500 million 3.875% Senior Notes due 2034. The notes are unsecured senior obligations ranking equally with existing unsecured senior debt. The offering is underwritten by Barclays, Citigroup, Commerzbank, HSBC, BNP Paribas, J.P. Morgan, Mizuho, and others, with proceeds to Amphenol of approximately €1.0957 billion before expenses. The notes will be listed on the NYSE and settled through Euroclear and Clearstream. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
